name: Banneret (Purple Dragon Knight)
summary: An inspiring leader who rallies allies on the battlefield.

features.name: Rallying Cry
features.short: When you Second Wind, heal up to three allies.
features.summary: When you use Second Wind, you can choose up to three creatures within 60 ft.; each regains hit points equal to your fighter level.

features.name: Royal Envoy
features.short: Persuasion with double proficiency, plus one social skill.
features.summary: You gain proficiency in Persuasion with double your proficiency bonus, and proficiency in one of Animal Handling, Insight, Intimidation or Performance.

features.name: Inspiring Surge
features.short: Action Surge lets an ally attack too.
features.summary: When you use Action Surge, you can choose one creature within 60 ft. to make a weapon attack with its reaction (two creatures at 18th level).

features.name: Bulwark
features.short: Share Indomitable's reroll with an ally.
features.summary: When you use Indomitable to reroll an INT, WIS or CHA save and you aren't incapacitated, one ally within 60 ft. that failed the same save can also reroll it.
